revise_description: In the stakeholder handoff for this case, the commercial owner framed the change in business terms rather than as a spreadsheet checklist. At the latest operating review, the business owner rejected treating this as a cosmetic rerun. The plan has to follow the commercial interpretation below, with the data-pack labels read literally. The workforce agreement now has a second review tier. The first 100 overtime labor hours are covered by the ordinary overtime arrangement; going beyond 100 hours adds a one-time 10-unit review burden to the production plan. The names shown in backticks are the exact field names used by the data packet and the audit trail.
